EMPLOYEES' OLD-AGE BENEFITS (VERIFICATION) REGULATIONS, 2007
EMPLOYEES' OLD-AGE
BENEFITS (VERIFICATION) REGULATIONS, 2007.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II 10th October, 2007]
S.R.O. 1025 (I)/2007, dated
9-10-2007.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 45 of the
employees' old-Age Benefits Act, 1976 (XIV of 1976), the Board is pleased to
make the following regulations, the same having been previously published vide notification
No. S.R.O. 572 (I)/2007 dated the 11th June, 2007, as required under subsection
(1) of that section, namely:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
These regulations may be called the Employee's Old-Age Benefits (Verification)
Regulations, 2007.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In these
regulations, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,---
(a) "Act" means the Employees' Old-Age
Benefits Act, 1976 (XIV of 1976);
(b) "Chairman" means the Chairman of
the Institution;
(c) "corroborative evidence" means---
(i) annual report or audited accounts;
(ii) published report of the establishment;
(iii) official record of any public office;
(iv) complaint from registered trade union or
collective bargaining agent of the establishment; or
(v) comparative study of the industries or
establishments of similar capacity, their process and machinery located in the
same area;
(d) "form" means form annexed to these
regulations;
(e) "Land Revenue Act" means the Land
Revenue Act, 1967, (W.P. Act XVII of 1967) as in force in the respective
province;
(f) "month" means one calendar month
for which contributions are payable;
(g) "region" means an administrative
unit in respect of field operation approved by the Chairman and notified
through an office order by the Institution from time to time and includes any
other department created by the Chairman;
(h) "Regional Head" means the incharge
of the region; and
(i) "team" means a team of officers of
the Institution, not below the rank of Assistant Director, constituted by the
Regional Head, duly authorized by a certificate in the form prescribed, to
check the record of the establishment.
(2) All other words and expressions used but not
defined shall have the same meaning as are assigned to them respectively in the
Act.
3. Verification of employer's record.---The
employer's record shall be subject to verification by a team, if the
employer,---
(a) fails to pay the contributions for
consecutive three months; or
(b) reduces the number of insured persons; or
(c) fails to submit the returns required under
the Employees' Old-Age Benefits (Contribution) Rules, 1976;
(d) does not enhance the number of insured
persons as required under subsection (1) of section 12 of the Act; or
(e) a complaint with corroborative evidence is
received.
4. Procedure for calling information for
verification of facts.---(1) The Regional Head shall issue show-cause
notice to the defaulting employer requiring him to show cause for his failure
enumerated in regulation 3 in appropriate form viz VR-001 to VR-005 attached
with these regulations.
(2) If the employer fails to respond to the show
cause notice or the reply is not up to the satisfaction of the Regional Head,
he shall constitute a team to verify the record of the said employer.
5. Verification of record.---(1) The
Regional Head shall inform the employer about the team and require him to
produce the record before it at a fixed date, time and venue in the form
prescribed.
(2) The team after inspection of record shall
submit its report along with evidence within fifteen days to the Regional Head.
(3) If the employer fails to produce the
documents as required under sub-regulation (1), the team shall assess the
amount of contribution due and submit the report within seven days to the
Regional Head along with the evidence relied upon for assessment.
